visual_checks.name: tile_grid_seams
visual_checks.evidence: Diff10 images for all three views show uniform speckle distributed over the object body with no horizontal or vertical lines at 32px or 16px spacing. Tile_structure_ratio values (17.14/17.28/18.14) are within the established architectural baseline of ~17-18; no new grid seams introduced.

visual_checks.name: tile_uniform_fill
visual_checks.evidence: No square constant-color 32x32 or 16x16 blocks visible in any render vs reference comparison. All three renders show continuous detail matching their respective references.

visual_checks.name: missing_splat_holes
visual_checks.evidence: No local dark regions or coverage holes larger than ~16px detected in hero, side, or top renders. Diff10 speckle is distributed uniformly over the object, not concentrated in large dark patches.

visual_checks.name: color_clipping_bands
visual_checks.evidence: No saturated R/G/B regions or flat-color stripes visible in any view. Color rendition matches reference across hero (warm ear tones, blue fur), side (dark blue fur), and top (gray-blue fur) views.

visual_checks.name: ringing_halos
visual_checks.evidence: No structured ringing or halos at object silhouettes observed in any of the three renders. Edge transitions appear natural with noise-level speckle only.

visual_checks.name: nan_inf_signatures
visual_checks.evidence: No pure-black, pure-white, or magenta spatially-correlated patches in any render. No fireflies (isolated 1-3px bright outlier dots) detected on inspection of all three rendered PNGs.

visual_checks.name: geometry_shift
visual_checks.evidence: Diff10 images do not show clean silhouette outlines of the object. The bright regions in diff10 correspond to textured surface noise, not a shifted geometry boundary.

visual_checks.name: diff10_structure
visual_checks.evidence: All three diff10 images are dominated by uniform speckle over the object body with no quilting blocks, gradients, or banding. Pattern is consistent with the established architectural bf16 pack_tile noise floor.

tile_structure_check.delta_vs_prev: Values are within the established architectural baseline of ~17-18 (architectural-baseline carve-out applies; bf16 pack_tile is the confirmed floor since iter-068). No new structural drift introduced — delta not exceeding +0.3 above prior architectural baseline.

reasoning: All visual checks pass. The three renders (hero, side, top) are visually indistinguishable from their references; diff10 images show only uniform speckle consistent with the established architectural noise floor. No tile grid seams, uniform-fill blocks, missing-splat holes, color clipping, ringing, NaN/Inf signatures, geometry shift, or fireflies detected. Tile_structure_ratio values (17.14/17.28/18.14) are within the established ~17-18 architectural baseline set by iter-068 and confirmed across subsequent iters; the architectural-baseline carve-out applies, and no new drift is introduced. PSNR for all views (hero 39.41, side 41.00, top 38.60) meets the dispatch-class floor of >38 dB and is bit-identical to the architectural baseline (hero 39.4, side 41.0, top 38.6). Timing at +0.54% vs prev_best is within the 2% break-even band; p99/median ratio of 1.195 is well under the 3× flag threshold. Per-view PSNR delta of 2.40 dB and ms ratio of 1.24 are both within consistency limits. KEEP as break-even with bit-identical quality.
